summary: feat(game-goat): store the IsThereAnyDeal key in credentials.toml
reason: The ITAD key was env-only (ITAD_API_KEY), so prices/price-history needed a per-shell export and auth set-token could not persist it. Adds itad_api_key to credentials.toml with env-over-stored precedence, auth set-token --provider itad, auth status/doctor reporting, and logout clearing, so the key is saved once and inherits the 0600 permission guard.

PATCH(amend-2026-09-28: ITAD key resolves env then stored credential)

PATCH(amend-2026-09-28: logout clears the ITAD credential too)
PATCH(amend-2026-09-28: doctor reports the optional ITAD credential)
